Black Orchid: dark boozy chocolatey flowers; cocoa, earthy truffle, plum, rum, creamy vanilla, patchouli, smoke; "greenhouse at night", "black velvet dress"; evening/cold/date, statement, not office; beast performance; love/hate.
Café Rose: dark creamy woody rose dusted with saffron+incense; coffee faint, toasty warmth; "rose pulled from the dirt at dusk", "sandalwood shavings soaked in rose water"; moody fall/evening rose, unisex; coffee barely shows; moderate perf (4-5h skin, lasts on clothes); 2023 reissue sharper, more transparent.
Noir: classic gentleman's powder; peppery slightly rubbery dark opening then powdery iris, rose, violet over vanilla, amber, incense, touch of leather; retro barbershop elegance modernized; suits/evenings; likened to Guerlain Habit Rouge/Shalimar ("out-Guerlained Guerlain"); strong perf; "black rubber flowers".
Noir Extreme: spiced dessert; cardamom, nutmeg over creamy milky kulfi with rose, orange blossom, vanilla, sandalwood; "cardamom ice cream", "dessert from a spice bazaar"; date night fall/winter; crowd-pleasing compliment-getter, gold-standard masc gourmand; compares Spicebomb Extreme, Khamrah, L'Homme Ideal; 6-10h, projects 2-3h then close; can be syrupy.
Ombre Leather: soft smooth black leather with jasmine+cardamom lift, dry dusty mossy base; "new leather jacket", "saddles and boots in desert heat", American West; everyday casual-dressy signature, jeans+leather jacket, cooler weather; gentler sibling of Tuscan; gateway for leather skeptics; cardamom opening sharp; 6-8h.
Oud Minérale: salty sea air, smoky driftwood, briny seaweedy, soft oud+amber base; "beachfront after rain", "bonfire on the beach", "a clean pirate"; fresh-but-bold marine for people tired of blue aquatics; mature; aquatic that lasts; opening can go fishy for some; 7-8h+.
Tuscan Leather: tart raspberry over raw smoky rich leather with saffron; "new car interior / Bentley seats", "expensive leather goods store", "petrol", "shoe polish"; bold power statement, not for faint of heart; compares Cuir de Russie, Montale Aoud Leather; very strong; luxury vs harsh petrol split.
Baccarat Rouge 540: airy burnt sugar / dry cotton candy with metallic saffron-jasmine edge over dry woods (pencil shavings) and salty mineral amber; "smells like money/rich"; luxury status, instantly recognizable, huge trail; you may stop smelling it on yourself; overhyped vs iconic; "dark red fruits swimming in amber".
Petit Matin: juicy fizzy lemon + orange blossom, soft lavender over clean musk; fresh laundry drying in sun; "a clean white shirt", "Paris at dawn"; spring/summer mornings, office, quiet luxury, unisex; 4-8h arm's length then close; "it whispers, inviting you to lean in"; critics: expensive laundry.
Ani: lemon cake/lemon bars + creamy vanilla + gingery kick; ginger-lemon vanilla cake, Christmas-market pastry; cozy polished unisex fall/winter evenings, some office; "expensive hotel lobby"; very strong 10-12h; small overrated camp.
Deziro: clean salty blue marine; mandarin + sea air, mint/anise, odd carrot-seed note, earthy vetiver; sunscreen/beach feel; summer daytime casual safe; constantly compared to Bleu de Chanel ("blue with a carrot twist"); split performance; least loved by enthusiasts.
Fan Your Flames: boozy rum + toasted almost burnt coconut over sweet pipe tobacco + tonka, mossy green finish; beach rum party / pirates burning coconuts; evenings cold weather bold fun not office; like Jazz Club / Tobacco Vanille; strong ~6h+ arm's length.
Fan Your Flames X: same coconut-rum-tobacco made softer, sweeter, more tropical; thyme, mastic; some fruity/bubblegum; smoother more wearable; split refined vs too sweet.
Hacivat: juicy pineapple + grapefruit over green oakmoss and woods; fresh mossy fruit chypre; versatile all-rounder; go-to Aventus alternative, greener mossier; beast 10-12h; "packs a punch".
Hundred Silent Ways X: soft fuzzy peach + creamy tuberose and gardenia over vanilla, light leather edge; sweet creamy florals; feminine-leaning sophisticated comforting; dates special; original likened to a better-blended Black Opium; 6-9h; "velvety fuzzy fruitiness".
Kredo: dry peppery spice (cardamom, pink pepper) turning to soft buttery suede and smooth oud + sandalwood, hint of apricot (osmanthus); quiet luxury, office/formal/evening, fall/winter; "Oud Wood with more performance"; long but close after 2h; "holds back, and that's a good thing".
Nefs: honey, fig, saffron becoming sweet boozy leather with rose and soft non-animalic oud; rich regal; fall/winter power scent unisex statement; monster 14-16h; "masterpiece"; overpowering if oversprayed.
Papilefiko: sweet lavender + fir forest with zesty cardamom + coriander drying to slightly sweet herbal resinous; "sweet minty forest"; relaxed feel-good fall/spring; compliment getter; Ropion; long.
Suède et Safran: saffron-spiced leather jacket; warm bittersweet saffron over soft suede + ginger then dark slightly smoky leather + musk; cold weather evening dates bold; Tuscan Leather alternative; split love/hate; "a tailored leather jacket spiced with saffron".
Tempfluo: bright orange + mandarin with saffron melting into sweet nutty praline with orange blossom + jasmine over creamy cashmere woods; celebratory nights out, Ibiza sunset (white isle memories, Anne Flipo); unisex leans feminine; like YSL Libre early; 10h+.
Tero: salted caramel + cracked pepper over spiced earthy patchouli and dry woods; salty mineral gourmand; autumn/winter bold warm; acquired taste; ~10h.
Wulong Cha: fruity citrusy cup of oolong tea turning to fig, creamy musk, soft woods; not smoky not grassy; summer daytime fresh classy unisex; wins over people who dislike tea; "a cut above the sea of blues"; moderate ~8h close.
Wulong Cha X: rounder softer more floral tea (magnolia); relaxed freshly brewed cup; more unisex; lasts longer, sits closer.
Uomo (2021): reworked current Uomo EDT; lemony citrus into powdery slightly makeup-counter iris over earthy vetiver, pepper warmth; clean polished; office/everyday smart-casual, fall/spring; quieter iris cousin of Prada L'Homme / Dior Homme Intense; subtle, close to skin.
Uomo Born in Roma Coral Fantasy: juicy red apple, then lavender+sage, drying to soft honeyed tobacco+patchouli; sweet fruity not dessert; young versatile crowd-pleaser dates/going out; cheaper apple-lavender cousin of PdM Layton; "should've been called Apple Fantasy"; moderate ~4-7h.
Uomo Born in Roma Green Stravaganza: bright slightly bitter bergamot + roasted cafe coffee (not milky) over clean vetiver settling to warm slightly salty amber; fresh and clean; daytime spring/summer work/casual; between Bleu de Chanel and Eros Flame; "coffee with a personality, not syrupy"; fades to coffee shadow.
Uomo Born in Roma Purple Melancholia: quick cardamom then dominant creamy coconut softened by clean lavender on sweet amberwood; sunny tropical, opposite of the name; playful casual dates warm weather; closest to JPG Le Beau; strong for EDT 6-10h; polarizing coconut.
Uomo Born in Roma Yellow Dream: juicy pineapple+mandarin into spiced gingerbread (cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg) drying to creamy vanilla+cedar; bakery with tropical twist; cheerful daytime; "a summer Stronger With You", "gingerbread with icing".
Replica Jazz Club: sweet boozy rum + vanilla over tobacco leaf, pink pepper; smooth honeyed not smoky; "cozy bar on a cold night"; evenings, cocktail bars, fall/winter, unisex; Tobacco Vanille's approachable little brother; skin scent after 3-4h, lasts on clothes.
Replica Coffee Break: milky sweet coffee + creamy lavender over vanilla/tonka; lavender latte; cozy calming; rainy days, sweater weather; coffee fades early; ~3h close.
La Nuit de L'Homme: cardamom-forward spice + smooth lavender, brief citrus, dries to soft cedar+vetiver; sweet-spicy intimate sexy; THE classic date-night scent, close-up not room-filling; "doesn't make a statement, and doesn't want to"; 2-4h close, spray clothes.
I Will: fresh bergamot, lavender, cardamom quickly into sweet vanilla over woody-leather; dark sweet leathery vanilla; evenings fall/winter mainstream crowd-pleaser; compares Stronger With You Intensely, Le Male Le Parfum, Boss Bottled Absolu; enthusiasts lukewarm (generic), retail buyers like it.
Homme Intense: powdery iris with cocoa, vanilla, musk; "lipstick on a gentleman"; woodier cedar dry down; suit-and-tie elegance, office/dates/evenings fall/winter; benchmark iris; 6-12h; "easy, effeminate and elegant".
Le Male Elixir: quick mint+lavender burst then sticky honey, tobacco, tonka, vanilla; marshmallow, caramel, s'mores; sweet but masculine; cold-weather evenings, dates, nights out, not summer/office; original Le Male on steroids, Ultra Male spiritual successor, "what 1 Million should have been"; beast 9-10h+, go easy on sprays; too sweet for some.
Eros Najim: candied orange + cardamom settling into warm caramel, smoky woody amber, faint polite oud; Eros with mint and apple stripped out; grown-up darker Eros; autumn/winter evenings dates; "opens like orange Skittles", "the most mature take on Eros yet"; good 8-12h, projects first couple hours.
Imagination: bright citrus then black tea + ginger with touch of cinnamon over clean ambroxan; expensive white soap / fresh laundry; "citrus drops in ice-cold water", "smells like clouds"; effortless polished freshie office/daytime spring/summer; softer refined Bleu de Chanel; skin-scent for some.
Althaïr: warm Bourbon vanilla lifted by orange blossom, cinnamon, praline; vanilla that stays fresh rather than dessert; some get caramel/apple pie; cozy cold-weather evening/date, leans masc; Layton DNA same perfumer; gentler Tobacco Vanille; performance split.
Kalan: sharp black pepper + blood orange opening (dusty, limestone), settling into sweet warm tonka-amber-wood drydown (the best part); dark mysterious winter/evening; "a masculine, woodier BR540"; for people who want less safe than Layton; strong 10h+; polarizing opening; "bad boy in a bottle".
Erba Gold: sunny basket of juicy fruit (melon, pear, apple, mango-ish) over bright citrus drying to clean creamy musk; unisex summer/holiday/evening cheerful attention-getting; Pura's smoother more grown-up sibling with spice; strong; "a bowl of sun-drenched fruit".
Erba Pura: loud candy-sweet fruit bomb (fruit candy, multivitamin juice, fruity shampoo) over heavy vanilla-amber white musk; going out, clubs, compliment-chasing, fills a room; beast; "people either follow me or flee"; polarizing.
Soprano: lychee+fruit into creamy milky rose with jasmine, apricot-like osmanthus over soft oud, patchouli, leather; jammy rose; romantic dressy fall/winter evenings unisex; strong; "a milk-sweet heart fattens the rose"; thin data.
Erba Leather: ripe passion fruit + citrus over smooth leather, jasmine as fruit fades, musky amber vetiver; bold evening/special; "best version of Erba Pura" / Erba Pura + Ombre Leather; beast, one spray; can be very sweet.
Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense: very peppery citrus turning dark and roasted: bitter coffee, burnt licorice over smoky lava rock mineral woods; original Terre made darker; classy masculine fall/winter evening, office ok; "a pepper hurricane", "Cuban cigars, leather couches and old wealth"; split vs original fans; 8-10h.
The One: warm honeyed pipe tobacco + amber with cardamom, ginger after short grapefruit/basil; smooth creamy slightly sweet; THE classic date-night pick, fall/winter evenings, mature gentlemanly; close-wearing skin scent 6-8h; "the quiet, reserved gentleman".
Gentleman Réserve Privée: soft whisky + powdery iris with roasted chestnut and benzoin; sweet nutty boozy drying to cedar vetiver patchouli; classy mature office or date cool weather; like Dior Homme Intense/Parfum; "boozy without being overpowering"; 4-6h close.
Uomo Signature: creamy sweet coffee + tonka with cinnamon, cardamom after bright mandarin + pink pepper, dries to darker leather-patchouli; evening/date fall/winter; "buttoning a leather jacket over a tailored suit"; great value; moderate.
